name: deep-research
description: Multi-source research automation that turns a question into a cited one-page brief: splits the question into sub-questions, fans out subagents over WebSearch/WebFetch, merges findings while keeping contradictions visible, and writes a verdict-first markdown brief where every claim carries an inline [n] citation into a numbered source list, with a citation_check.py gate that rejects bare claims and orphan citation markers.
